edits.text: Two Shang graphs made from 門 and 口 were traditionally read as 問, but their identification and descent from the later 問 graph remain disputed. One tentative alternative treats them as expanded forms of 啟; their inscriptional meaning is unclear. The received Shuowen analysis of the later form does not settle this earlier reading.

The use of 問 meaning “ask” or “inquire” is reported in late Warring States Qin slips. This is the earliest clear graph for that use in the evidence discussed here; it does not establish that the spoken word began then or that asking was its original meaning.
問 has the established use “ask” or “inquire,” reported for late Warring States Qin slips. This relationship represents that attested use; whether it was the word’s original meaning is unresolved.
